results.description:
Caring for Mom or Dad shouldn't mean chaos in the family group chat.

Caregiver is a family care coordination app for adult children and siblings caring for an aging parent. Each loved one gets one care hub with a shared calendar, medication tracker, tasks, care logs, vitals, document vault, and live updates, so everyone in the care circle stays aligned without endless texts.

Whether you're coordinating care at home, in assisted living, or from a distance, Caregiver helps families manage senior care in one shared place. Care is shared, visible, and organized so nothing gets missed. Families stay aligned, reduce stress, and spend less time tracking updates - and more time supporting the people they love.

SHARED MEDICATION TRACKER
Log doses, set reminders, and reduce "Did Dad take his meds?" anxiety. Everyone in the family sees what matters in one shared log.

SHARED CAREGIVER CALENDAR & APPOINTMENTS
Put doctor visits, therapies, and appointments in one shared calendar so siblings, helpers, and primary caregivers stay aligned—even across cities.

SHARED TASKS, CARE CHECKLISTS & DUE DATES
Turn vague worries into a shared task list: errands, follow-up items, home safety tasks, and care plan steps with notes and due dates everyone can act on together.

SHARED CARE LOGS, VITALS & HEALTH TRENDS
Log blood pressure, pulse, blood sugar, temperature, mood, and daily notes in one place. Bring clearer context to appointments and spot patterns over time.

SHARED DOCUMENT VAULT FOR ELDERLY PARENT RECORDS
Keep insurance cards, IDs, medication lists, and visit notes in one secure place, so the right file is there in stressful moments.

SHARED FAMILY UPDATES WITHOUT THE UPDATE TEXTS
See recent activity across medications, tasks, appointments, care logs, and documents. Fewer repeated questions; clearer accountability for everyone helping Mom or Dad.

FREE TO START
Essentials for care coordination are available without blocking the basics behind a paywall: calendar, tasks, medications, and care log notes. Free is your care hub as admin. Inviting family to edit with you is Premium — often with a short intro trial when Apple still offers one. Subscriptions (paid by the care hub admin) also add more loved one profiles, expanded document storage, health trend charts, and longer care log history. Invited family benefit on hubs they share.

PRIVACY & TRUST
Your family's information matters. We're supported by optional Premium subscriptions—not banner ads. Published by Calming Aura Studios LLC. Review our Privacy Policy in the app or on our website.

LEGAL
Terms of Use (EULA): https://calm-aura.github.io/tos_and_privacy/caregiver/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy: https://calm-aura.github.io/tos_and_privacy/caregiver/privacy-policy.html

Caregiver supports care coordination; it does not replace professional medical advice. Always follow your health professional's guidance.

Caregiver24.7 is a caregiver-centric Integrated Attention Alert & Action System, a productivity app which can be integrated with the Caregiver24.7 attention requirement sensing devices for caregivers of seniors and the clinically-dependent at home, availing nursing-home-like monitoring at a household level, giving caregivers peace of mind and the freedom to attend to other responsibilities.



Unlike fragmented monitoring solutions, the app incorporating collaborative support provides a unified command console for multiple caregivers to remotely and seamlessly oversee the attention needs of all their dependent individuals at home. The caregiver is also able to monitor the attention needs of multiple dependents at different locations.


Anyone may become a caregiver of a family member one day, like it or not. A caregiver often lives in a state of trepidation and feels stuck in the role for an extended period, thus appreciates any moment of temporary relief to evade burnout or depression. This concerning phenomenon is widely acknowledged, but little practical is available for caregiver relief.


With Caregiver24.7 Integrated Attention Alert & Action System, the caregiver can afford to step away momentarily from dependents to attend to errands or personal pursuits, or rope in peripheral support network for coordinated attention and caregiving.


The app also allows the caregiver to freely set reminders for any routines, from complicated medication regimen to chores like changing or positioning the patient or ordering of supplies.


The app thus indirectly prompts the rendering of tender loving care and attention to loved ones in need at home, an act which sometimes can be inadvertently lost amid one’s many other commitments. In the process, the caregiver’s anxiety or sense of guilt for being unable to be physically present all the time can also be mitigated.

results.description:
Walkies is the all-in-one platform for dog walkers, pet sitters, groomers, boarders, and anyone running a pet care business. Track walks with live GPS, manage your clients, send automatic updates to pet owners, handle invoicing and payments, and run your entire business from your pocket.

TRACK EVERY SERVICE
Record walks with live GPS routes, photos, videos, distance, and duration. Log drop-ins, boarding stays, grooming sessions, daycare, training, overnight sits, taxi trips, and meet and greets. Add pee and poop markers to the map and send beautiful report cards to owners when you're done.

YOUR CLIENTS, ALL IN ONE PLACE
Store every pet, owner, contact detail, access instruction, and note in detailed client profiles. Create contracts, attach documents, and archive old clients when you need to.

APPOINTMENTS AND BOOKINGS
Manage your schedule with a clear calendar view. Set your availability, enable client booking, and sync with Google Calendar or Apple Calendar. Handle recurring appointments, cancellation policies, and special hours.

STAY CONNECTED
Send real-time updates, photos, and ETAs to pet owners automatically. Message clients through the in-app inbox, or broadcast announcements to everyone at once with your built-in CRM.

INVOICING AND PAYMENTS
Create invoices in seconds. Set up recurring invoices, accept payments with Walkies Pay powered by Stripe, and let clients pay with Apple Pay, saved cards, bank transfer, cash, check, or Zelle. Handle deposits, partial payments, tipping, and refunds.

FINANCE DASHBOARD
See your profit, loss, revenue, and expenses in one place. Track every business expense with receipt scanning. View payment reports, service breakdowns, and financial forecasts.

MILEAGE AND TRAVEL
Log every trip with odometer readings and distance tracking. Generate mileage reports for your records or tax returns.

OFFLINE MODE
No signal? No problem. Walkies works offline so you never miss a beat — track walks, view appointments, and access client info without an internet connection. Everything syncs automatically when you're back online.

TEAM MANAGEMENT
Add team members, track their locations live during walks, and manage payroll with per-service rates and PDF reports.

CARPLAY
View appointments, get directions, start and end taxi trips, and track travel logs from your car's display.

APPLE WATCH
Track walks, log pees and poops, and view widgets right from your wrist.

WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITIES
See appointments, pet birthdays, unpaid invoices, and quick actions on your Home Screen. Track active walks live in the Dynamic Island.

SIRI
Ask Siri about your next appointment, or add pee and poop counts during a walk — hands-free.

ACHIEVEMENTS
Unlock over 100 milestones as you grow, with collectible 3D digital stickers you can share.

EVEN MORE
Custom branding with your company colors and logo. Apple Health. Dark mode. Full iPad support with responsive layouts and sidebar navigation. Apple Intelligence. Liquid Glass for iOS 26.
